call_goal: Show Calder Ridge Software eval scores per feature; learn what lands; book a dated next step

transcript.text: And this dashboard rolls up the eval scores per feature, so you can see helpfulness and correctness trending week over week.
Can our PMs see these dashboards too, or is it just engineers?

knowledge.title: Workspace roles
knowledge.text: Arize AX workspaces use role-based access. Admins can give teammates view-only access to dashboards and monitors without edit rights.

unacceptable_behaviors: Answers with a counter-question first ("Which PMs?") before answering
Claims more than the source says (free or unlimited seats, single sign-on)
Ignores the question and carries on with the demo
acceptable_questions: Yes, admins can give PMs view-only access to dashboards. Which PMs would use them?
